companyDescription: Commercial CNS/immunology pharma · Fanapt, HETLIOZ, BYSANTI (Q4 2026 launch) · Quimilza (imsidolimab, GPP) PDUFA Dec 12, 2026 · tradipitant sNDA planned · Q3 revenue $69.8M (+24%), FY26 guide >$240M
priceNote: Live $3.49 (+1.2%, Nov 23 close, Yahoo). It sits right on the $3.45 52-week low, ~41% below the 200-day (~$5.90) and ~64% below the $9.56 high.
summary: A revenue-generating pharma priced near its lows into an FDA decision. Quimilza (imsidolimab) for generalized pustular psoriasis has a PDUFA of Dec 12, 2026, per FDA BLA acceptance and partner AnaptysBio's release. Q3 revenue rose 24% to $69.8M (Fanapt +24%), Q3 opex fell 18% q/q, FY26 revenue guidance is >$240M, and BYSANTI launches in Q4. Consensus is ~$11.75–14 (+240%+, 4–5 analysts), with B. Riley at $12 and H.C. Wainwright at $20. Cash fell ~$123M year to date per one unverified recap, so the balance sheet is the risk. The catalyst is 18 days out, beyond the 14d North Star window. Base +25% is the approval move over 3–4 weeks. ค่าขนม — 2% max.

catalysts.name: Quimilza (imsidolimab) FDA decision — PDUFA Dec 12
catalysts.description: BLA for generalized pustular psoriasis (partnered with AnaptysBio). FDA accepted the filing; AnaptysBio's Sep 2026 release lists Dec 12, 2026 as the target action date. Dec 12 is a Saturday, so the news may land Friday Dec 11 or Monday Dec 14.

catalysts.name: BYSANTI commercial launch
catalysts.description: Management lists the Q4 2026 BYSANTI launch as a near-term milestone; MDD adjunct Phase 3 results are expected in H1 2027.

risks: Cash burn: one recap puts cash down ~$123M from Dec 31, 2025 (unverified vs the 10-Q); continued losses could force financing.
Small market: GPP is a rare indication and Boehringer's Spevigo is already approved, so the approval is more validation than a revenue step-change.
HETLIOZ Q3 sales included ~$7M of timing-shifted orders; underlying growth is slower than the headline.
Thin coverage (4–5 analysts) and a history of FDA disputes; micro-cap liquidity.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00%. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~91% (Nov 23); futures dropped the 50bp tail after the November selloff.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct core CPI +0.3% m/m (hot). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y; Oct PCE (Nov 25) consensus 3.2% is the last inflation print before the Fed.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: A commercial-stage pharma is not rate-driven; the swing factor is the FDA binary and whether the balance sheet needs equity in a weak tape.
